requirements.description: The standard-8d Dragon Tiger profile deals Dragon first from an eight-deck shoe, compares ranks ace-low without suit tie-breaks, and applies the documented main-bet returns.
requirements.notes: Allocated by GitHub issue #77 for issue #83; deterministic tests cover eight-deck shoe creation, three-card burn, 52-card reserve, Dragon-first dealing, ace-low rank comparison, 1:1 main returns, 11:1 Tie, and half-loss rounding.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own isolated reload-safe Dragon Tiger shoe state, settled rounds, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Normal-user session context overrides caller-supplied player ids, and settled Dragon Tiger history and shoe metadata survive backend restart.

requirements.description: Dragon Tiger wager debits and settlement credits use the shared ledger exactly once under stable action identifiers and immutable request fingerprints.
requirements.notes: Game code never mutates balances directly; exact retries recover immutable wager and optional settlement proof while changed requests fail closed.

requirements.description: The Dragon Tiger surface and persistent shared shell provide complete English and Russian copy and remain responsive, accessible, and reduced-motion safe across required viewports.
requirements.notes: Acceptance covers both locales, all four named viewports, ready and settled play, tie half-loss, exact replay, reduced motion, route restoration, localized persistent shell copy, and active-route navigation visibility.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery automatically include Dragon Tiger with requirement, module, version, and visual evidence traceability.
requirements.notes: The descriptor uses sort order 100 and the normalized tests.game_drivers.dragon_tiger:play driver reference released by issue #77.

requirements.description: Dragon Tiger publishes shoe progress, prepared actions, recovery markers, bounded terminal history, and durable replay evidence through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale action can overwrite or resurrect the winning result, while debit and settlement recovery retain the frozen v1 behavior and exactly-once ledger movements.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, standard-8d shoe, card ordering, payout math, ledger transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
